dedupe_keys.name: an annotated street view image dataset for automated road damage detection

description: An annotated street view image dataset for automated road damage detection is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Miao Ren et al. Road damage is a great threat to the service life and safety of roads, and the early detection of pavement damage can facilitate maintenance and repair. Street view images serve as a new solution for the monitoring of pavement damage due to their wide coverage and regular updates. Coverage: not stated; published in 2024. Formats: TXT, XML, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through the repository address listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
